text.what: The white end of the family. A further mutation that can come from pinot gris or pinot noir and can go back the other way, which is why nurserymen watch their mother vines.
text.story: Henri Gouges found a white-berried shoot in his Nuits-Saint-Georges vineyard and propagated it; the wine is sold as Nuits-Saint-Georges blanc. *Inference —* nothing published suggests it is more than a selected mutation of the pinot noir already growing there.

kin.as: The parent form; the mutation runs both ways.
Its neighbour on the colour ladder.
